span.p: 《货币强权》

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: "书籍信息"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "作者：本杰明·J.科恩，美国国际政治经济学教授"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "译者：张琦 等 · 中信出版社 2020"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "原版：Currency Power · 普林斯顿大学 2015"

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: "全书十章 · 24.8万字"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "原名直译应为货币实力，书名取货币强权"

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: "核心命题"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "蒙代尔：强大的国家拥有强大的货币"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "货币与国力互为内生 · 双向因果同时成立"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "货币权力曾是长期被忽视的研究领域"

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: "框架与主线"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "铺垫章：第1章 货币国际化 · 第2章 国力分析"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "理论章：第3章 货币实力 · 第4章 货币到实力 · 第5章 实力到货币"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "应用章：第6章 现状 · 第7章 美元 · 第8章 欧元 · 第9章 人民币"

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: "总结章：第10章"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "主线：货币金字塔→货币实力→双向因果→三判词"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "第1章 国际货币：经济学底座"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "六功能分类：私人层面 外汇·贸易计价·金融市场 ＋ 官方层面 汇率锚·干预·储备"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "货币竞争类似格雷欣法则，但方向相反：良币驱逐劣币"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "胜出条件：信心 · 金融深度 · 网络规模"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "货币金字塔七层：顶级→贵族→精英→平民→被渗透→准→伪"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "现代只有美元居于顶级，欧元日元为贵族"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "收益与成本：五项收益 · 三项风险"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "误置具体性：不能只算可量化账目"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "第2章 国力分析：政治学底座"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "四问框架：含义 · 来源 · 运用 · 界限"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "影响力是让人做不愿做的事 · 自主权是不被别人影响"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "自主权是影响力的必要条件"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "来源之争：资源要素思路 vs 关系结构思路，两者互补"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "实力三面相：强制 · 结构 · 软实力"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "实力诅咒：对实力的寻求埋下毁灭的种子"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "第3章 货币实力：全书概念枢纽"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "货币实力＝避免收支调整成本的能力"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "调整成本一分为二，对应两只手"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "持续性调整成本：新平衡的永久损失，全由逆差国承担"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "对应延迟能力：依靠储备与借款 · 货币国际化增强借款能力 · 无泪赤字"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "过渡性调整成本：转变本身的代价，可以转嫁他人"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "对应转移能力：依靠开放度与适应性 · 来自结构变量"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "金融机构是持续不断的民意测验"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "金字塔等级＝避免调整负担而让他国承担的能力"

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: "第4章 从货币到实力"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "私人三功能＋官方三功能逐一检验"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "外汇与贸易功能：经济收益大 · 政治收益近于零"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "价值储藏功能才是实力核心：自主权上升 · 网络中心位上升"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "案例：巴拿马1988冻结美元 · 伊朗金融制裁"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "汇率锚反是负担：发行国成了国际货币体系的人质"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "贸易功能间接塑造央行储备偏好"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "金融＋贸易＋储备三合一 ＝ 嚣张的特权"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "时间因素：外债积累 → 实力诅咒 → 生命周期"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "顶级货币衰落 → 沦为协商货币 · 挽留成本高昂"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "惯性时滞：英镑衰落用了半个世纪"

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: "第5章 从实力到货币"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "德国马克：区域冠军 · 金融封闭 · 冷战前线，止步区域性"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "日元：泡沫破裂 · 被动改革 · 无人追随，逐渐枯萎"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "欧元：早期惊艳 · 见顶回落"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "国力四要素：经济规模 · 金融发展 · 对外政策关系 · 军事影响力"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "四要素不可互换：存在互换性问题"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "功能分布不均：规模催贸易 · 金融催价值储藏 · 军事提供安全避风港"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "有管理的国际化：历史上并无成功先例"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "衰落有时滞：拜占庭博赞特延续约八百年"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "生命周期两部曲：良性循环 → 恶性循环"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "第6章 当今世界的货币竞争"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "放弃单极多极说法 · 改用集中度"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "HHI＝份额平方和 · 大于0.25即集中度过高"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "现状：非对称的货币双极 · 美元为尊"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "日元 · 英镑 · 瑞士法郎只是陪跑"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "人民币2013年外汇份额刚过2％ · 仍是小矮人"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "过去的二十五年 · 竞争结构几乎没有变化"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "结论：多极化尚未成为新常态"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "第7章 美元：未衰减的实力"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "悲观论：特里芬难题 · 2013年净负债4.5万亿美元"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "反驳：赤字回落至GDP的2.4％ · 海外持有约22万亿债权"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "价值储藏独一无二：流动性 · 安全性 · 安全溢价"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "2008危机是最好检验：外资净买5000亿 · 美联储任全球最后贷款人"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "贸易网络外部性：一半出口以美元计价 · 是欧元的两到三倍"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "政治军事护航：约130国900个军事据点"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "协商货币检验：流传很广 · 但证据不足 · 不是"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "五类成本：挤兑 · 抛售 · 声望 · 汇率管控权 · 过度的责任"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "判词：不可或缺的货币 · 举世无双"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "第8章 欧元：未实现的实力"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "德洛尔预言落空：弱小的欧元会变得强大?"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "根源：欧元是一种没有国家的货币"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "货币政策规则与财政政策规则不匹配"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: "第三条腿 财政自动转移支付 从未被认真考虑"

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
